messages:
Maya (support): Hey team — customer hit a rerank failure that reports \"token limit exceeded\" but their payload looks fairly small. They attached a repro and say it fails intermittently when query contains long pasted text.

OpsBot: Auto-triage -> 413-like response. Logged as rerank.limit. request_id=rb-0a1b2c3d. Suggested: check aggregate token count (query + passages) and any non-UTF8 characters.

Maya (support): Repro from customer (sanitized): they POST to /v1/rerank with body: 3 docs, each ~9k chars, query ~6k chars. Server returns 413 with message: \"input too large, token limit exceeded\". They expect a clearer hint: which field hit the limit?

Liam (eng): Thanks — this is likely hitting our total token ceiling per rerank request (query + all passage tokens). Docs+query ~33k chars -> ~6k tokens, but our limit for rerank aggregation is 4096 tokens for this model variant. Failure path currently returns a generic 413. Can you paste the raw headers + request_id so I can find trace?

Maya (support): request_id=rb-0a1b2c3d, customer attached curl and a sample JSON. They want a repro curl snippet we can run against staging.

Liam (eng): Repro curl to run quickly (truncate docs to safe size to repro):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{
    "model":"rerank-small",
    "query":"<paste ~6k chars here>",
    "docs":[
      {"id":"a","text":"<9k chars>"},
      {"id":"b","text":"<9k chars>"},
      {"id":"c","text":"<9k chars>"}
    ]
  }'
```

Liam (eng): Quick diagnostics you can run locally: count tokens with our tokenizer helper, or approximate by tokens = chars * 0.25 for long text. If total_tokens > 4096 you'll hit the ceiling. Recommend we return a structured error with fields: code, message, limit, actual_tokens, culprit_field.

OpsBot: Log trace found: rb-0a1b2c3d -> rerank-service -> reject at pre-parse stage. Suggestion: surface field-level breakdown in client error.

Maya (support): Sounds good. Can you draft the customer-facing error message change so I can pass to docs/ux? Also need suggested mitigation steps (client-side chunking snippet).

Liam (eng): Draft message for UX: \"Request rejected: combined token limit exceeded. Limit: 4096 tokens. Request: 7124 tokens. Culprit: \u2018docs\u2019 field (total passages). Suggestions: shorten query, limit number/length of docs, or split into multiple rerank calls with fewer passages. See example snippet: use sliding-window chunking and call /v1/rerank per chunk, then merge top-k.

Liam (eng): Example client-side chunking (pseudo):
```python
chunks = chunk_texts(passages, max_chars=2000)
results = []
for c in chunks:
  r = client.rerank(model=\"rerank-small\", query=query, docs=c)
  results += r.scores
# merge sort top results
```

Maya (support): Perfect — I'll file a docs ticket (DOCS-524) and send the customer a tailored response with the repro curl + above mitigation steps.

OpsBot: NOTE: prod metric spike for rerank 413 errors +12% in last 24h. Recommend follow-up with runtime team if docs rollout doesn't reduce volume.

Maya (support): Thanks team — assigning to Liam for the error payload change and to Docs for messaging. I'll update the customer and close once we confirm doc changes."
